_comment: Tempo's ElevenLabs agent as code. push_agent.py fills in the prompt and first message from the .md/.txt files next to this. No secrets and no personal facts here: ElevenLabs keeps agent config whatever the retention setting.
name: Kairos
_llm_note: 24 Oct 22:55: switched from deepseek-v41-flash (ElevenLabs' default, hosted by ElevenLabs) to gemini-2.5-flash, because DeepSeek produced '#invalid_tool_call' and never called ask_tempo (reproduced with simulate.py). Gemini runs via Google Cloud (Vertex AI), so Google processes the conversation text: say so on the data card. To change: edit llm here, push_agent.py, then simulate.py to confirm tool calls work.
_backup_note: Backup LLMs (other vendors, chosen for reliable tool calls) are used only if Gemini fails. If one kicks in, Anthropic (via Google Vertex) or OpenAI process that turn.
_session_note: The Kairos app passes secret__kairos_session (from POST /api/voice/session) as a dynamic variable; ask_tempo sends it as X-Kairos-Session. Callers that don't pass it (web page, dashboard test, simulate.py) get the placeholder 'none', which the hub must treat as no session.
